name: @metabob/mcp
description: MCP server exposing Metabob analysis capabilities to AI agents

scripts.start: bun run preflight && bun run src/index.ts
scripts.test: bun run preflight && bun test tests
scripts.build:model: bun run preflight && bun run scripts/copy-model-assets.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:model && bun build src/cli.ts --target node --outdir dist --external onnxruntime-node --external tree-sitter --external tree-sitter-javascript --external tree-sitter-python --external tree-sitter-typescript && bun run scripts/finalize-cli.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run build

author: Metabob Inc.
